items.title: SSA-794185: RADIUS Protocol Susceptible to Forgery Attacks (CVE-2024-3596) - Impact to SIPROTEC, SICAM and Related Products

fix.t: Conﬁgure the RADIUS server to require the presence of a Message-Authenticator attribute in all Access-Request packets from RADIUS client devices that support it
Restrict access to the networks where RADIUS messages are exchanged (e.g., send RADIUS traffic via management network or a dedicated VLAN)
Update to V10.0 or later version

items.title: SSA-864900: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Fortigate NGFW before V7.6.6 on RUGGEDCOM APE1808 Devices

fix.t: Update Fortigate NGFW to V7.4.9 or later following the secure update recommendation procedure. Contact customer support to receive detailed information
Under the config vpn ipsec phase1-interface configuration, either set authmethod to psk, or set digital-signature-auth to disable (see https://fortiguard.forti…
For each interface, remove "fabric" access (see https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-25-084)

items.title: CVE-2025-40572
products: SCALANCE LPE9403 (6GK5998-3GS00-2AC2) < V2.1.0 with SINEMA Remote Connect Edge Client installed

fix.t: Restrict access to authorized and trusted personal only
Update to V4.0 HF0 or later version
Disable the Profinet Discovery and Configuration Protocol (DCP) service
Conﬁgure the RADIUS server to require the presence of a Message-Authenticator attribute in all Access-Request packets from RADIUS client devices that support it
Restrict access to the networks where RADIUS messages are exchanged (e.g., send RADIUS traffic via management network or a dedicated VLAN)
Update to V10.0 or later version

items.title: CVE-2024-32122
products: RUGGEDCOM APE1808 with Fortinet NGFW < V7.4.9
RUGGEDCOM APE1808 with Fortinet NGFW < V7.6.6

fix.t: Update Fortigate NGFW to V7.4.9 or later following the secure update recommendation procedure. Contact customer support to receive detailed information
Under the config vpn ipsec phase1-interface configuration, either set authmethod to psk, or set digital-signature-auth to disable (see https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-24-373)
For each interface, remove "fabric" access (see https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-25-084)
